oracle.rootCause: The original object permits local mock fallback after request failure, but the source does not provide that fallback for all admitted product IDs. A valid remote-list product id=42 routes to detail; on detail request failure, MockData.commodityById(42) searches only local ids 1..8 and returns undefined. The cast as Commodity creates no object; the detail page assigns undefined and remains in its loading branch. This is a concrete incomplete failure path, not a blanket objection to mock or missing runtime proof.
